source.form: NEHA Tech Inspection Form (page 1, standard) and NEHA Tech Inspection Form X Car (page 2)
source.rules: New England Hillclimb Association Rules, 2026 Edition

items.label: Helmet
items.accepts: Snell SA2015 or newer (SA2015 discontinued after the 2026 season); FIA 8860-2010, 8859-2015, 8860-2018 or 8859-2024 less than 10 years from manufacture; good condition

items.label: HANS
items.accepts: HANS FIA 8858-2002 or 8858-2010, Hybrid FIA 8858-2010, or SFI 38.1 with conformance label less than 5 years old

items.label: Tether no older than 5 years
items.accepts: Tethers less than 5 years old

items.label: Suit
items.accepts: FIA 8856-2000 or 8856-2018; SFI 3.2A/5 or 3.4/5; FIA 1986 or SFI 3.2A/1 only with FIA 8856-2000 or SFI 3.3 underwear; nothing worn over the suit
options: SFI 3.2A/1 with FIA 8856-2000 or SFI 3.3 undergarments

items.label: No rips, tears, oil stains
items.accepts: Suit covers neck to ankles and wrists; clean, no defects, stains, holes or frays

items.label: Long pants / long shirt (X car)
items.accepts: Full clothing (long sleeves, long pants, socks) of fire-resistant material such as cotton, linen, leather or wool; no meltable synthetics

items.label: Fire suit
items.accepts: Fire suit in good condition, worn instead of fire-resistant long pants/long shirt (a certified suit is not required for X cars)

items.label: FIA or SFI gloves
items.accepts: SFI or FIA rated gloves, no stains or holes

items.label: Belts
items.accepts: 5-, 6- or 7-point SFI 16.1/16.5 or FIA 8853/2016 or 8853/98 harness; not past tagged expiration or more than 5 years from manufacture (untagged = out of date); no Y or V shoulder harness

items.label: Belts not mismatched
items.accepts: Complete harness set, parts not mixed between sets; not altered from original condition

items.label: Belt angles
items.accepts: Belt angles per SFI installation guide, FIA App. J Art. 253 section 6.2, or harness manufacturer

items.label: Belt anchoring points
items.accepts: Anchor points per installation guide, each capable of 3300 lbf (OE anchor points adequate); correct hardware

items.label: Pins in clips if used
items.accepts: Safety pins fitted in snap-hook clips where clips are used

items.label: Triple wrapped belts
items.accepts: Wrap-around mounts and adjusters threaded/locked per harness manufacturer

items.label: No fraying
items.accepts: Belts in good condition, no fraying; OE 3-point belts are adequate for X cars

items.label: Proper mounting
items.accepts: Seat mounted to substantial structure in line with harness loads (OE mountings adequate); with a 5+ point harness, fixed-back racing seat

items.label: No play
items.accepts: No play in the seat

items.label: No alteration
items.accepts: Seat not altered; safe condition

items.label: Seat fitment for all drivers (if shared car)
items.accepts: Seat width and height fit each driver; headrest max. 3 in behind the helmet

items.label: Cage padding where head could hit bars
items.accepts: High-density shock-absorbing padding (SFI or FIA) on any cage member the driver's head can reach

items.label: 2.5lb ABC fire extinguisher
items.accepts: Min. 2.5 lb ABC portable extinguisher with gauge, within reach of the driver, not on the driver's footwell floor

items.label: Extinguisher tag within 3 years
items.accepts: Inspection tag or manufacture date within the last 3 years

items.label: Extinguisher anti-torpedo bracket
items.accepts: Bracket securely mounted with anti-torpedo tab

items.label: Extinguisher metal bracket / strap
items.accepts: Metal bracket and latching metal strap; over 2.5 lb net needs an extra metal restraint

items.label: Extinguisher gauge in green
items.accepts: Gauge reads in the green

items.label: Air horn
items.accepts: Compressed air horn secured within reach of the driver

items.label: Battery positive covered
items.accepts: Positive terminal covered with a non-conducting cover

items.label: Battery sealed from driver
items.accepts: Battery securely mounted and sealed from the driver; insulated box if sharing a compartment with the fuel tank

items.label: Spill kit
items.accepts: Disposal (trash) bag carried for fluid-spill debris

items.label: Fuel cell bulkhead
items.accepts: Gas tank or fuel cell sealed from the driver (SFI/FIA fuel cells count as sealed); secure, no leaks

items.label: Kill switch in Prepared and FL cars
items.accepts: Prepared and FL classes: switch isolates all electrical power, marked with lightning bolt symbol and OFF position

items.label: Fuel lines run inside the cage
items.accepts: Fuel lines securely mounted and protected from heat, collision and abrasion

items.label: Wires run inside the cage
items.accepts: No frayed, loose or pinchable wires; battery cable not through frame rails or cage tubing

items.label: No loose objects, no floor mats
items.accepts: No loose objects, carpets or mats; small items in a closed compartment or secured

items.label: Spare tire removed or properly secured
items.accepts: Spare removed or securely restrained

items.label: No excessive oil leaks
items.accepts: No oil leaks; no excessive oil in the engine compartment

items.label: Oil catch can
items.accepts: Oil overflow catch can or breather system, or OEM system in place

items.label: Oil catch can or OEM PCV
items.accepts: Oil overflow catch can or breather system, or OEM system in place

items.label: Firewall between engine and driver
items.accepts: Firewall between engine and driver

items.label: Brake fluid full
items.accepts: Master cylinder full, no leaks

items.label: Battery positive covered
items.accepts: Positive terminal covered with a non-conducting cover

items.label: Numbers
items.accepts: Legible numbers on both sides with class designation, max. 3 numerals, no leading zeros; other drivers' numbers covered

items.label: X if required
items.accepts: "X" after the number on breakout vehicles

items.label: X
items.accepts: "X" after the number

items.label: R if required
items.accepts: "R" after the number on Rally vehicles

items.label: DOT windshield or lexan or helmet with visor
items.accepts: DOT windshield or polycarbonate (Lexan) windshield, or full-face helmet with visor; no acrylic/Plexiglas

items.label: Minimal play in wheel bearings and ball joints
items.accepts: Ball joints, bushings and rod ends within manufacturer spec; wheel bearings minimal play and secure

items.label: No missing or loose lug nuts
items.accepts: No missing or loose lugs; no cracked, broken or badly bent wheels

items.label: Tires in good condition
items.accepts: Street tires: visible tread full width, no cord separation, DOT number, good condition
